Initial release of the markdown-convert skill.

- Supports converting Markdown to standalone HTML (with basic styling).
- Converts Markdown to PDF, returning the file as a base64 string.
- Transforms HTML or HTML fragments into editable Markdown.
- Handles input from local files or raw content.
- Includes structured error messages for missing input, missing dependencies, and file-related issues.
- Designed for use without an API key and easy integration in conversations.
